planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno. Wired pins preserved: HC-SR04 Trig=D8, Echo=D9; LED=D13; buzzer/tone=D6; serial baud 9600 with framing line_or_idle.

Business timing/thresholds to be implemented in SysML: when distance<=10cm trigger LED fast blink and buzzer three short beeps and emit serial 'welcome'; if no one within 5s return to idle (stop blink/beeps and suppress welcome).

Ultrasonic acquisition sample_period_ms is not encoded in ports; SysML should schedule an acquisition period that is a multiple of control_period_ms and compatible with timeout_us. timeout_us set to 30000 within supported 25000..60000, and SysML should use the required bounded pulseIn budget including acquisition time.

Serial protocol/text was not explicitly specified as an exact fixed string. To remain within supported typed reporting, this proposal reports an i32 welcome_state=1 when the welcome gate triggers. If an exact fixed text 'welcome' (and no number) is required, replace with serial_text_output using text 'welcome' instead of the numeric typed value (not provided as fixed in the source requirements).
LED output is modeled as a single digital_command that SysML uses to drive the fast-blink pattern (blink timing belongs in SysML, not in the port).
Buzzer requirement 'three short鸣' is modeled using tone_output; SysML should drive duration/pause between the three beeps using elapsed_ms and set the tone_output frequency accordingly.
